title: asclepias syriaca var. kansana
intro: Asclepias syriaca var. kansana, commonly known as the Canadian Milkweed or Narrowleaf Milkweed, is a perennial plant native to North America. It is a member of the milkweed family (Asclepiadaceae) and is known for its medicinal properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Asclepias syriaca var. kansana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal benefits.
